summary: The source contract limits n to 30, and the resulting terms are too small to distinguish linear fragment assembly reliably from quadratic repeated copying through runtime scaling.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer from 1 through 30.

replacement_checks.evidence: Complete-domain regression establishes L_t <= L_n for every 1 <= t <= n <= 30. Each transition scans one current term and emits its next term once, so total work is at most 30 L_n; list accumulation avoids repeated partial-output copying.
Regression derives every term for n from 1 through 30 with an independent group-by oracle, verifies nondecreasing term lengths, and checks both the app-local and immutable native sources exactly.
